title: Unit Catch-Up Late Fee Figure by Unit Class: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Schedule Extract
content:
**Schedule rule.** The late fee counted in the unit catch-up amount on a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization is the maximum late fee when the late-fee percentage of rent times the contracted monthly rent, rounded to the cent, is above the maximum late fee; that percentage amount when it is above the flat late fee; and the flat late fee otherwise. The figures are those of the unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement, and the percentage is applied to the contracted monthly rent.

**Ladder.**

| Percentage of the contracted monthly rent, rounded to the cent | Late fee counted |
|---|---|
| Above the maximum late fee | The maximum late fee |
| Above the flat late fee, not above the maximum | The percentage amount |
| Not above the flat late fee | The flat late fee |

**Class figures and the late fee counted at sample contracted rents (hypothetical rents).**

| Unit class | Flat late fee | Maximum late fee | Percentage of rent | Rent $100.00 | Rent $200.00 | Rent $400.00 | Rent $600.00 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $20.00 | $45.00 | 20% | $20.00 | $40.00 | $45.00 | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $20.00 | $45.00 | 20% | $20.00 | $40.00 | $45.00 | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $25.00 | $55.00 | 15% | $25.00 | $30.00 | $55.00 | $55.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $25.00 | $60.00 | 15% | $25.00 | $30.00 | $60.00 | $60.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $30.00 | $75.00 | 10% | $30.00 | $30.00 | $40.00 | $60.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $30.00 | $75.00 | 10% | $30.00 | $30.00 | $40.00 | $60.00 |

**Reading the boundaries.** On a Bluegate Climate Plus unit, a rent of $400.00 gives a percentage amount of $60.00, equal to the $60.00 maximum and not above it, so $60.00 is counted as the percentage amount; a rent of $400.20 gives $60.03, above the maximum, so the maximum of $60.00 is counted. On a Bluegate Drive-Up Standard unit, a rent of $100.00 gives $20.00, equal to the flat fee and not above it, so the flat $20.00 is counted; $100.05 gives $20.01, which is counted.
